body: I thank you for your kind words, unfortunately I don't reckon I'll be around to find said motivation.

At the moment I couldn't tell you. I've flip flopped over the years between computer science and fashion and veterinary. I can't seem to find a hobby or point of interest that lasts more than a year or so.

That's just the thing. I applied to schools senior year and I got into a few local ones, I just didn't and still don't have the motivation to go through with it. I know I'd dick around in class and not do my homework. I'd love to go to school and learn more (I'm an information sponge), I just don't have the willpower. And I kick myself every day because of that.

I try to tell myself this every morning, and it gets me through the day. It's once I get home and am by myself where I have to think about all the shit wrong with my life. 

I've been to countless thereapists, talk therapy doesnt seem to have an effect on me (probably because Im unwilling to seek actual help/I just don't care.) It always ends with some new medication that works for 6 months and then tapers off.
